title: Fix al-knowledge follow-ups and document the skill
summary: The al-knowledge skill now accepts JavaScript technology queries alongside AL, and the knowledge response validator now rejects contradictory citation records and duplicate references to prevent validation errors.
key_points: Extended al-knowledge skill to support JavaScript technology queries for control-add-in and UI article requests
Validator now rejects articles cited in both references and suppressed lists, and duplicate reference paths
Knowledge-response contract explicitly states each article path appears at most once across references and suppressed arrays
Updated documentation to include al-knowledge skill in capability lists and troubleshooting guidance
Added regression tests covering suppression reasons and contradictory duplicate citations
